sloka: तस्मिन् हते भीमपराक्रमेण प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे।मही सशैला सवना चचाल भयं च रक्षांस्यधिकं विवेश ।। ६.७६.९४ ।।
transliteration: tasmin hate bhīmaparākrameṇa plavaṅgamānāmṛṣabheṇa yuddhe।mahī saśailā savanā cacāla bhayaṁ ca rakṣāṁsyadhikaṁ viveśa ।। 6.76.94 ।।

translations.english: Struck in the chest by Sugriva's fist, Kumbha fell down and shone like the Sun god over powered by Rudra।।
